rule: Layered data, each layer INCLUDEs the one below: (L1) base template holds body animation key, sound keys, melee and threat range and the flying flag; (L2) element overlay = one animation line in the variant base plus a monster file that sets the element's resist pair and its ranged power id (fire 173, ice 172); the ice bolt carries a slow status; (L3) tier stats per file, hand-set; (L4) behaviour knobs per file (chance_pursue, chance_flee, flee timing and range, threat range, melee and ranged power weights); (L5) promotion: a spawn variant is one INCLUDE of the parent plus one passive power; named elites carry a defeat tag and passive immunities; (L6) labyrinth scaling via stat_per_level lines. Resist patterns: standard +25 own / -50 opposite; labyrinth +50 / -50; late +50 / -25 (levels 11 to 16). Donor design rule: higher level means smarter ranged creatures, and ice is a little less careful than fire.

keep: One body per family; element as an overlay (animation sheet, resist pair, projectile key).
Tier as a stat row per level; labyrinth scaling as stat-per-level lines.
Behaviour knobs as numbers per creature (pursue, flee, threat range, power weights).
Spawn variant as one INCLUDE plus one passive power.
Named elite as base plus defeat tag plus passive immunities.
Idle as an 8-frame looped stance at 800 ms.
Ice less careful than fire, as the donor's own design rule (observed in two pairs).
change: Ice wyvern template names a water animation sheet (wyvern_ice.txt:3). Fix: look up the sheet by element id and fail the load when it is missing.

Power id 132 means different things in different namespaces (beacon base, magician power, skill tree node). Empyrean beacon uses 161. Fix: reference powers by key; reject duplicate or unknown ids at load.
Resist patterns vary with no named rule. Fix: three named pattern rows in one element table; each element points at one pattern id.
Hand-set stats per file with no tier table; xp runs to large powers of two in named tiers. Fix: xp from the tier row, override only for named elites.
lvl13_zombie_miner.txt has no base INCLUDE. Fix: give it a base or mark it as a set piece.

Frankendom mapping: 700 zones as data rows (base, element id, tier, promotion) reusing the 100 Pit characters; pursue, flee and threat knobs read by the engine's target and leash logic (row 4, row 2), with MAX_ATTACKERS 3; beacon pull as a capped data power; element status and damage server-side, element sheet and hit sound client-side (rows 7, 10, 12).
look_test: Build one flying or walking base in the existing fight scene behind a look flag, with three looks from one body (plain, fire, ice). Each look has its own projectile (orange bolt; blue bolt that leaves a short slow ring). Play the 8-frame idle at 800 ms. Publish to /preview/ with no release rows. Dom checks at 375 wide with the fight camera: can he name the element in under one second without the HUD, and do the three read as one family?
